purpose: Named sponsor/product cases that may represent real animal-study displacement or regulator reliance but do not yet meet the full regulator-verified threshold for inclusion as confirmed adoption precedents.

candidates.product_or_program: BAL0891 + immune checkpoint inhibitor / tislelizumab combination IND amendment
candidates.claimed_displacement: Traditional animal efficacy/proof-of-concept studies replaced by efficacy data from a human vascularized tumor immune microenvironment organ-on-chip model
candidates.alternative: Qureator vTIME human vascularized tumor immune microenvironment model with AI-supported analysis
candidates.verification_note: Qureator explicitly attributes the FDA IND amendment to an efficacy package using vTIME without traditional animal proof-of-concept. SillaJen independently confirms the collaboration and FDA IND amendment, but a public FDA record causally linking the regulatory decision to omission of animal proof-of-concept has not yet been located.
candidates.promotion_rule: Promote only after a public FDA review document, FDA statement, sufficiently detailed sponsor regulatory filing, or equivalent authoritative record verifies the displacement claim.

candidates.claimed_displacement: EMA assessment text states that conventional toxicology, carcinogenicity, genotoxicity, mutagenicity and reproductive toxicology studies were not performed for the allogeneic EBV-specific T-cell product, while selected immunodeficient-animal studies addressed narrower pharmacology/safety questions.
candidates.alternative: Product-specific cellular characterization, clinical evidence and tailored nonclinical studies rather than a conventional toxicology battery
candidates.verification_note: The indexed EMA assessment text is strong and directly states the omitted conventional study classes, but direct PDF rendering remained rate-limited during this pass. No independent HTML regulator review with equivalent detail was located yet.
candidates.promotion_rule: Promote after direct page-image verification of the EMA report or independent regulator-authored confirmation of the same omitted-study logic.
